name: Golden Mask: The Werewolf Story
source: You play as Ramona, a senior high school student living in Reno, Nevada. She lives with her dad since her mom passed when she was a small child. Reno is isolated from the rest of the world by the desert and no one seems to travel in or out. It is under control of demons who occupied the city and play brutal games with people's lives and minds. The citizens can't understand that they're brainwashed and Mona is the only one who knows about the occupation and is able to comprehend the games they play with people. The story starts with a new game by the demons at Ramona's school - the werewolf, where the only options are to kill or be killed.
translation: 你扮演雷蒙娜，一名住在内华达州里诺的高中生。自从她小时候妈妈去世后，她就和父亲住在一起。里诺被沙漠与世界其他地方隔绝，似乎没有人进出。它被占领城市的恶魔所控制，对人们的生命和思想进行残酷的游戏。公民无法理解他们被洗脑了，而莫娜是唯一了解这一职业并能够理解他们与人们玩的游戏的人。故事始于雷蒙娜学校的恶魔们推出的新游戏——狼人，唯一的选择就是杀人或被杀。
